d:
Get moving after your meal with this 20-minute walking workout for beginners! This low-impact walk is performed at a comfortable, steady pace and is a great way to add gentle movement to your day while supporting healthy blood sugar levels.
This beginner-friendly walking workout is designed at a suitable pace for after eating or after a meal. No equipment is needed, and the simple, low-impact movements make it suitable for beginners, adults 50+, and anyone looking for an easy way to get more daily movement.
What you'll get in this workout:
20-minute beginner walking workout
Low-impact cardio
